name: HireVue
summary: HireVue sells video interviewing with on-demand and live interviews, automated scheduling and shared scorecards for reviewers. Its pricing page names no plans or prices and offers a demo request instead.

facts.text: The product page says candidates can respond on their own time, and that live interviews happen in real time with the interviewer and candidate on the call together.
The product page says the platform includes automated scheduling.
The product page says HireVue provides standard rating scales and shared scorecards, and that reviewers can watch, rate and share recordings.

plans.name: Demo and quote
plans.notes: The pricing page lists products but no pricing tiers. It offers a Book a Demo option.

hiddenCosts: No plan names, prices or minimums are published in the text read from the pricing page.
